name: ons-list-item
description:
[en] Component that represents each item in a list. The list item is composed of four parts that are represented with the `left`, `center`, `right` and `expandable-content` classes. These classes can be used to ensure that the content of the list items is properly aligned. ```
Left
Center
Right
Expandable content
 ``` There are also a number of classes (prefixed with `list-item__*`) that help when putting things like icons and thumbnails into the list items. [/en] [ja][/ja]
examples:
Title
Subtitle

modifiers.name: tappable
modifiers.description:
[en]Make the list item change appearance when it's tapped. On iOS it is better to use the "tappable" and "tap-background-color" attribute for better behavior when scrolling.[/en]
   [ja]タップやクリックした時に効果が表示されるようになります。[/ja]

modifiers.name: chevron
modifiers.description:
[en]Display a chevron at the right end of the list item and make it change appearance when tapped.[/en]
   [ja][/ja]

modifiers.name: longdivider
modifiers.description:
[en]Displays a long horizontal divider between items.[/en]
   [ja][/ja]

attributes.name: modifier
attributes.description:
[en]The appearance of the list item.[/en]
[ja]各要素の表現を指定します。[/ja]

attributes.name: lock-on-drag
attributes.description:
[en]Prevent vertical scrolling when the user drags horizontally.[/en]
[ja]この属性があると、ユーザーがこの要素を横方向にドラッグしている時に、縦方向のスクロールが起きないようになります。[/ja]

attributes.name: tappable
attributes.description:
[en]Makes the element react to taps. `prevent-tap` attribute can be added to child elements like buttons or inputs to prevent this effect. `ons-*` elements are ignored by default.[/en]
[ja][/ja]

attributes.name: tap-background-color
attributes.description:
[en] Changes the background color when tapped. For this to work, the attribute "tappable" needs to be set. The default color is "#d9d9d9". It will display as a ripple effect on Android.[/en]
[ja][/ja]

attributes.name: expandable
attributes.description:
[en]Makes the element able to be expanded to reveal extra content. For this to work, the expandable content must be defined in `div.expandable-content`.[/en]
[ja][/ja]

attributes.name: animation
attributes.description:
[en]The animation used when showing and hiding the expandable content. Can be either `"default"` or `"none"`.[/en]
[ja][/ja]

methods.name: showExpansion
methods.description:
[en]Show the expandable content if the element is expandable.[/en]
[ja][/ja]

methods.name: hideExpansion
methods.description:
[en]Hide the expandable content if the element expandable.[/en]
[ja][/ja]
